DATOS_PERSONALES.contenido:
PERSONAL DATA PROCESSING POLICY

In accordance with Law 1581 of 2012 and Decree 1377 of 2013, Pet Pals requests your authorization for the processing of your personal data.

1. DATA CONTROLLER
Pet Pals is responsible for the processing of your personal data.

2. PURPOSE
- Create and maintain your account
- Facilitate connections with caregivers
- Improve platform experience
- Comply with legal obligations

3. DATA COLLECTED
- Identification information (name, email, phone)
- Location data (with your consent)
- Information about your pets
- Transaction and walk history

4. YOUR RIGHTS
You have the right to:
- Access your data
- Request corrections
- Request deletion (right to be forgotten)
- Revoke your consent
- File complaints with the Superintendence of Industry and Commerce (SIC)

5. VALIDITY
This consent is valid for 12 months from acceptance and will be required upon expiration.
